title: Reverse Survivors: difficulty tiers
objective: Add three difficulty tiers - Haunting, Normal and Crusade - scaling enemy hp and speed, the survivor's health, director income, and the length of the night. Normal must be the exact identity tier so no existing behaviour or assertion changes.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check` passes standalone: tsc --noEmit clean, eslint --max-warnings 0 clean, vitest at 100% on all four metrics.
Normal is exactly 1.0 on every multiplier, so all pre-existing raw-value assertions hold unchanged.
An explicit duration argument still overrides the tier's duration.
Changing difficulty restarts the game on the new tier, and restarting preserves the selected tier.
out_of_scope: Endless mode: fmtTime(Infinity) renders Infinity:NaN and would need a guard plus tests for a mode whose only content is the same game but longer.
localStorage persistence of the chosen tier: its catch arm is only reachable by stubbing a throwing setItem, which tests the mock rather than the game.
verifier: npm run check (typecheck + eslint --max-warnings 0 + vitest --coverage at 100%), plus an App-level test asserting the clock changes from 5:00 to 6:00 when Crusade is selected
